spikes.label: No way to reach a human

9.text: My account was suddenly limited and $41 of my funds are being held with no explanation. Each time I call they tell me the account is under review and they cannot give me a timeline. I have sent every document they asked for including my ID, bank statements and invoices but the hold is still there. This is my money and I need it to pay rent and bills. Holding it for six months is unacceptable.

Without any notice the company froze my account and is holding $820 for 180 days. I have screenshots of everything. Each time I call they tell me the account is under review and they cannot give me a timeline. I have sent every document they asked for including my ID, bank statements and invoices but the hold is still there. I run a small business and this hold has stopped me from paying my suppliers.

12.text: I accidentally sent $146 to a stranger with the same name as my friend. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

I accidentally sent $2,683 to a stranger with the same name as my friend. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. I want help getting my money back.

The app autofilled the wrong contact and my payment of $143 went to someone I do not know. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. There was no confirmation showing the recipient's full name before I sent it. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

3.text: My account is restricted until I verify my identity but the verification system will not accept my ID. I have screenshots of everything. The photos are clear and my information matches but it still says we could not verify you. Meanwhile I cannot access my balance of $76. I want a person to manually review my documents.

The app keeps asking me to verify my identity and rejects every document I send. This has caused me a lot of stress. Meanwhile I cannot access my balance of $1,256. The photos are clear and my information matches but it still says we could not verify you. I want a person to manually review my documents.

8.text: I paid an express fee to send $787 abroad and the money still has not arrived after 13 days. They asked for more information about the recipient after I had already sent the money. Support keeps telling me to wait another 48 hours and opens a new ticket every time. If they cannot deliver it they should return the money instead of holding it.

I paid an express fee to send $2,640 abroad and the money still has not arrived after 7 days. I contacted them on XX/XX/XXXX and again on XX/XX/XXXX. The status just says pending and the recipient bank says they have not received anything. Support keeps telling me to wait another 48 hours and opens a new ticket every time. If they cannot deliver it they should return the money instead of holding it.

I sent $2,344 to my family in XXXX and the app promised delivery within minutes but it has been 30 days. Support keeps telling me to wait another 48 hours and opens a new ticket every time. The status just says pending and the recipient bank says they have not received anything. My family needed this money for medical bills. I want it delivered or refunded including the fee.

1.text: I bought something online for $159 and the merchant sent a counterfeit product. The dispute was closed automatically after the merchant uploaded a fake tracking number. They told me to resolve it with the merchant directly, who does not respond. Their buyer protection policy did not protect me at all.

I was charged $252 twice by the same merchant. I opened a dispute with tracking and photos but the company sided with the merchant without reviewing my evidence. The dispute was closed automatically after the merchant uploaded a fake tracking number. I want my money back for a product I never got.

I paid a merchant $414 using my wallet and never received the item. My case number is XXXX. I opened a dispute with tracking and photos but the company sided with the merchant without reviewing my evidence. They told me to resolve it with the merchant directly, who does not respond. Their buyer protection policy did not protect me at all.

7.text: My instant transfer did not go through but the fee was still taken. Support said the fee is non refundable even though the service was not delivered. They returned the money to my balance but kept the fee. I want the fees refunded.

I paid the instant transfer fee to move $4,429 to my bank but the transfer failed. This has caused me a lot of stress. They returned the money to my balance but kept the fee. Support said the fee is non refundable even though the service was not delivered. If the instant transfer is not instant I should not be charged for it.

I was charged for an instant transfer to my debit card that took 31 days to arrive. I have screenshots of everything. This has happened multiple times and the fee is kept every time. If the instant transfer is not instant I should not be charged for it.

10.text: After years as a customer my account was shut down with no explanation. They will not tell me which policy I violated. My linked bank account is now blocked from opening a new account too. Closing accounts without any reason is unfair.

My account was permanently closed today without any warning or reason. My remaining balance of $84 has not been returned. My linked bank account is now blocked from opening a new account too. I want an explanation and my money returned.

I received an email saying my account is closed and I can no longer use the service. They will not tell me which policy I violated. My remaining balance of $75 has not been returned. Closing accounts without any reason is unfair.

11.text: My account was hacked and the password and security settings were changed before I could do anything. Two factor authentication did not stop it because they changed the phone number on file first. Customer service said the transactions came from a recognized device so they consider them authorized. I never authorized these transactions and I want them reversed and my account secured.

Someone logged into my account from another device, changed my email and phone number, and sent $416 to an account I do not know. Customer service said the transactions came from a recognized device so they consider them authorized. I was locked out of my own account and the hacker drained my balance and linked bank account. The company should have flagged a new device changing every security setting at once.

I received a code by text I did not request and minutes later my account was used to make transfers totaling $4,667. I was locked out of my own account and the hacker drained my balance and linked bank account. Customer service said the transactions came from a recognized device so they consider them authorized. The company should have flagged a new device changing every security setting at once.

6.text: I was charged a fee I was never told about when sending $4,418. The fee is buried in the exchange rate markup and is not disclosed clearly. The confirmation screen showed one amount and the receipt showed another. Fees should be shown clearly before you send money, not after.

I was charged a fee I was never told about when sending $410. When I asked support they could not explain how the final amount was calculated. The confirmation screen showed one amount and the receipt showed another. Fees should be shown clearly before you send money, not after.

The exchange rate I was charged on my transfer of $2,513 was much worse than the rate shown before I confirmed. I have been a customer for 4 years. The confirmation screen showed one amount and the receipt showed another. When I asked support they could not explain how the final amount was calculated. Fees should be shown clearly before you send money, not after.

5.text: I sent $813 through the app to a seller on XXXX for a puppy that never existed and the seller blocked me right after. They denied my refund claim in less than a day without asking me a single question about what happened. When I filed a claim they told me peer to peer payments are not covered by purchase protection and closed the case. I am asking the CFPB to help me get a real investigation of this scam.

I was contacted by someone pretending to be from XXXX who said my account was compromised and told me to send $72 to myself to secure it. I have screenshots of everything. I reported the scam within hours but the company said the payment was authorized by me so they will not refund it. When I filed a claim they told me peer to peer payments are not covered by purchase protection and closed the case. The scammer's account is still active on the platform. I want my money back and I want them to warn customers.

I sent $145 through the app to a seller on XXXX for a puppy that never existed and the seller blocked me right after. They denied my refund claim in less than a day without asking me a single question about what happened. When I filed a claim they told me peer to peer payments are not covered by purchase protection and closed the case. There was no warning in the app before I sent the money even though the recipient account was brand new.

4.text: My crypto withdrawal is stuck and I cannot sell or move my coins. Support only replies with automated messages saying the team is looking into it. The status says processing but the transaction never appears on the blockchain. The price has dropped while my funds were stuck and I lost money because of their delay.

I tried to withdraw my bitcoin worth about $86 to my external wallet and the withdrawal has been pending for 25 days. My case number is XXXX. The status says processing but the transaction never appears on the blockchain. Support only replies with automated messages saying the team is looking into it. The price has dropped while my funds were stuck and I lost money because of their delay.

The platform disabled withdrawals on my account while I had $43 in virtual currency. My case number is XXXX. Support only replies with automated messages saying the team is looking into it. They now say I need to complete additional verification even though my account was already verified. The price has dropped while my funds were stuck and I lost money because of their delay.

2.text: Their phone line says to use the app and the app says to call the phone line. The chat agent disconnects as soon as I explain the problem. Emails get a reply saying they are experiencing high volume and to be patient. I just want someone to look at my account and fix the issue.

I have tried for 16 days to get help and only get a chatbot that sends me in circles. I contacted them on XX/XX/XXXX and again on XX/XX/XXXX. Emails get a reply saying they are experiencing high volume and to be patient. The chat agent disconnects as soon as I explain the problem. I just want someone to look at my account and fix the issue.

There is no way to reach a real person at this company. I contacted them on XX/XX/XXXX and again on XX/XX/XXXX. The chat agent disconnects as soon as I explain the problem. Emails get a reply saying they are experiencing high volume and to be patient. I just want someone to look at my account and fix the issue.
